instruction:
You are a civil drainage engineer checking a task-owned synthetic SSC-11 stormwater outlet, flap-gate, and HGL package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. Manning hydraulic calculations, stormwater HGL review workflows, flap-gate product coordination, and outfall support routes shape the workflow context only; they are not extra data sources for this instance.

## Scene

- Product family: `SSC-11-LH-04`
- Drainage calculation: `DRAIN-SSC11-004`
- Flap-gate datasheet: `FLAP-SSC11-004`
- Tailwater table: `TAIL-SSC11-004`
- Outlet pipe/support detail: `PIPE-SSC11-004`
- Coordination memo: `MEMO-SSC11-004`

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Pipe diameter | {{ pipe_diameter_m }} m |
| Design flow | {{ design_flow_m3_s }} m3/s |
| Pipe length | {{ pipe_length_m }} m |
| Manning n | {{ manning_n }} |
| Tailwater level | {{ tailwater_level_m }} m |
| Flap-gate loss coefficient | {{ flap_gate_loss_coefficient }} |
| Minor-loss coefficient | {{ minor_loss_coefficient }} |
| Upstream invert | {{ upstream_invert_m }} m |
| Road surface level | {{ road_surface_level_m }} m |
| Pipe support line load | {{ pipe_support_line_load_kn_m }} kN/m |
| Support span | {{ support_span_m }} m |
| Flap-gate weight | {{ flap_gate_weight_kn }} kN |
| Support allowable | {{ support_allowable_kn }} kN |

## Checks

- Pipe velocity equals design flow divided by pipe area.
- Manning friction slope uses full-pipe area and hydraulic radius.
- Flap-gate and minor losses equal their loss coefficients times velocity head.
- Upstream HGL equals tailwater plus friction, flap-gate, and minor losses.
- HGL clearance equals road surface level minus upstream HGL.
- Pipe crown clearance equals road surface level minus upstream invert minus pipe diameter.
- Outfall support reaction equals pipe line load times support span plus flap-gate weight.
- Overall pass score is `1.0` only when HGL, pipe crown, and support checks pass; otherwise it is `0.0`.

## Output Format

Write a compact memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Preserve the object IDs above and state whether the baseline source pack passes the current docs-only checks.

Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "pipe_velocity_m_s": <numeric_value>,
  "friction_loss_m": <numeric_value>,
  "flap_gate_headloss_m": <numeric_value>,
  "minor_loss_m": <numeric_value>,
  "upstream_hgl_m": <numeric_value>,
  "hgl_clearance_to_surface_m": <numeric_value>,
  "pipe_crown_margin_to_surface_m": <numeric_value>,
  "outfall_support_reaction_kn": <numeric_value>,
  "support_utilization": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```

# ABOUTME: Defines the SSC-11 stormwater outlet flap-gate HGL template.
# ABOUTME: Pins one synthetic drainage, tailwater, flap-gate, and support source package.

[meta]
name = "stormwater-outlet-flap-gate-hgl-package"
description = "SSC-11 stormwater outlet HGL, flap gate, and support metrics"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound stormwater outlet metrics from a deterministic SSC-11 task-owned source pack. The template combines full-pipe Manning friction, flap-gate headloss, minor loss, upstream HGL clearance, pipe crown clearance, outfall support reaction, and an overall synthetic pass score."
discipline = "civil"
category = "stormwater-outlet"
standards = ["Manning hydraulic calculations", "Stormwater HGL review workflows", "Flap-gate product coordination", "Outfall support checks"]
tags = ["civil", "stormwater", "outfall", "flap-gate", "hgl", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.pipe_diameter_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "PIPE-SSC11-004 outlet pipe diameter"
min = 0.75
max = 0.75

[params.design_flow_m3_s]
type = "float"
unit = "m3/s"
description = "DRAIN-SSC11-004 design stormwater flow"
min = 0.5694627558483623
max = 0.5694627558483623

[params.pipe_length_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "PIPE-SSC11-004 full-pipe outlet length"
min = 48.53773926377916
max = 48.53773926377916

[params.manning_n]
type = "float"
description = "PIPE-SSC11-004 Manning roughness"
min = 0.013
max = 0.013

[params.tailwater_level_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "TAIL-SSC11-004 tailwater level"
min = 4.851
max = 4.851

[params.flap_gate_loss_coefficient]
type = "float"
description = "FLAP-SSC11-004 flap-gate loss coefficient"
min = 1.794885529584038
max = 1.794885529584038

[params.minor_loss_coefficient]
type = "float"
description = "DRAIN-SSC11-004 outlet minor-loss coefficient"
min = 0.6966989884569621
max = 0.6966989884569621

[params.upstream_invert_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "DRAIN-SSC11-004 upstream invert level"
min = 4.35
max = 4.35

[params.road_surface_level_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "DRAIN-SSC11-004 road surface level over the outlet"
min = 6.2
max = 6.2

[params.pipe_support_line_load_kn_m]
type = "float"
unit = "kN/m"
description = "PIPE-SSC11-004 outfall pipe support line load"
min = 4.0
max = 4.0

[params.support_span_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "PIPE-SSC11-004 support span"
min = 4.0
max = 4.0

[params.flap_gate_weight_kn]
type = "float"
unit = "kN"
description = "FLAP-SSC11-004 flap-gate weight"
min = 5.7
max = 5.7

[params.support_allowable_kn]
type = "float"
unit = "kN"
description = "PIPE-SSC11-004 outfall support allowable reaction"
min = 32.0
max = 32.0

[outputs.pipe_velocity_m_s]
description = "Outlet pipe velocity"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.friction_loss_m]
description = "Full-pipe Manning friction loss"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.flap_gate_headloss_m]
description = "Flap-gate headloss"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.minor_loss_m]
description = "Outlet minor loss"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.upstream_hgl_m]
description = "Upstream hydraulic grade line"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.hgl_clearance_to_surface_m]
description = "Road-surface clearance above upstream HGL"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.pipe_crown_margin_to_surface_m]
description = "Road-surface clearance above pipe crown"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.outfall_support_reaction_kn]
description = "Outfall support reaction including flap-gate weight"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.support_utilization]
description = "Outfall support reaction divided by allowable reaction"
tolerance = 0.03

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "Pass score for the task-owned HGL and support checks"
tolerance = 0.03
